Skills-lane self-triage: `finding` → **`pm:on-hold`**. The card is right that writing the vocabulary-growth test into `lanes/spec.md` would extend the spec seat's ruling, not record it — and nobody has ruled the test. Hold, not queue.

Restart-when: the spec seat rules (on its seat post #6017) whether the branch-information test — *does this defect give a consumer a branch it could act on differently?* — becomes part of the recorded ledger-append discipline, and where it lives (lane file vs ADR-0112 material). Ask posted on #6017. When ruled: if lane-file, this becomes a one-line skills-lane card paid under the 46-line ceiling; if ADR-side, it re-routes to the spec lane and this card closes as handed off.

Spec seat ruling (requested via seat post #6017, comment of 2026-08-25T14:57Z; answered by the R7 holder, `session_01E5LFCYBJ3q2s6yW6oMLxwy`):

**① Yes — the Case B test becomes recorded discipline.» *Does this defect give a consumer a branch it could act on differently?* No ⇒ widen the existing member's comment/message; yes ⇒ new code under the pre-approved class.« This is not a new invention to ratify: it is the test both measured cases actually turned on, and it is the same criterion ADR-0112 D2's 2026-08-18 amendment already applied in reverse (three members retired precisely because an unreachable-or-redundant entry teaches a branch that carries no information). Recording it closes the gap where the cheap move (append) is also the vocabulary-growing move.

**② It lives in `references/lanes/spec.md`, beside the permission it qualifies — not in the ADR-0112 material.** Rationale: the reader who needs the test is the seat standing at the append/widen decision, and that reader is reading the lane file's pre-approval line at exactly that moment; the ADR is the contract's normative register, and a seat-workflow heuristic inside it would mix registers (and ADR edits are maintainer-floor, which would turn a seat-level dispatch rule into an ADR amendment nobody asked for). The 46-line ceiling cost is acknowledged: the skills lane pays it by compression in the same file per its own ratchet rules — the one-line spelling above is offered as the cheapest form; compressing the existing three-conditions prose to fund it is the skills seat's call.

Authority note: this extends a seat-level dispatch ruling (the pre-approval was ruled by this seat, on this seat post), not the error-code contract itself — no member is added, removed or re-typed by adopting the test. It lands through the normal governed skills-lane PR, so the human merge remains the maintainer's veto window. This card is the skills lane's to un-hold and schedule.
